threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still carry an umbrella when the sun’s out—locals know the rain's a surprise, but it doesn't stop us from enjoying the park.
Caught a guy on the 47 last night, passionately arguing with an empty seat about politics. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh kebabs mixing with the sound of street musicians at Hermannplatz late at night—only then did I know I belonged here.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a club where DJ sets mix with live graffiti art. It’s a whole vibe that screams Berlin creativity.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a local knows to avoid the Civic Center BART at night—loud bangs and smoke have become way too common for comfort.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a dog in a backpack on Muni today, calmly watching the world go by. Only in SF do pets have better transit etiquette than some humans.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but the real charm lies in the hidden plazas where locals sip espresso and catch up, far from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll notice them lingering at the entrances of local bars, studying the menu like it’s a novel, while the regulars just order without looking.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a 'night out' means waiting in line for a cocktail at a bar instead of hitting a basement rave until dawn. Welcome to Dalston!
Saw a bloke in a full lion costume on the 50 last night, just swaying to his headphones while everyone else was half-asleep. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I caught the scent of grilled döner mixed with fresh flowers from the weekly market on Weserstraße. That’s when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you get a random techno party springing up in an abandoned building, complete with old-school graffiti on the walls and a line of people waiting to get in.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows the sweet spot for burritos on 24th is near the laundromat, not the fancy taco truck everyone raves about.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 7, complete with a top hat and a rubber chicken. Only in the TL, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think they can stroll into a vermut place at 6 PM for a seat, but locals know that’s when they’re packed, especially on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still fumbling with their SIM cards outside the phone shop, completely ignoring the local 'perdona' before asking for help.
